items.description: Floor cleaning, connection check and skirting replacement
items.rationale: The hose leak is covered under §2.4.2 even while the policyholder was away. Under §§7.1.5 and 7.1.7, allow about €85 for cleaning the affected floor, €70 to check the source and confirm it no longer leaks, and €260 to remove and replace about 10 m of damaged skirting like for like.

Sections 7.1.7(b), (e) and (g) cover necessary moisture measurement, equipment hire and labour in both affected rooms. Allow about €200 for one drying unit for ten days and €250 for measurement, setup, monitoring and removal, with no separate electricity allowance under §7.1.8(d).

items.description: Assessment and drying of framed decorative print
items.rationale: The mass-produced print is movable household contents excluded by §4.3(d), not an item of particular value eligible under §5.2.6. If eligible, a brief specialist assessment and simple drying would cost about €110 gross.
